description: This file defines the ClientConnectionOptions class that manages configuration options for client connections in an Orleans-based system. It includes methods to add configuration delegates and to apply those configurations to a connection builder.

classes.name: ClientConnectionOptions
classes.description: Provides options for configuring client connection behavior, including adding and applying connection configuration delegates.

methods.name: ConfigureConnection
methods.description: Adds a configuration delegate for the connection. The delegate modifies the connection builder.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Applies the stored connection configuration delegates to a given connection builder.
